convertibility_reason: Uses no indicators, only price comparison with fixed SL/TP in points. Simple single-position market order logic with CTrade standard library. No external libraries affecting trading logic, no custom indicators, no complex money management.

other_exits: On buy TP hit, close position and set bs=true (next trade will be buy again)
On buy SL hit, close position and set bs=false (next trade will be sell - reversal)
On sell TP hit, close position and set bs=false (next trade will be sell again)
On sell SL hit, close position and set bs=true (next trade will be buy - reversal)

custom_logic_notes: Alternating buy/sell flag logic (bs variable): On TP hit, the same direction flag is preserved (repeat same direction). On SL hit, the direction flag flips (reversal). Initial state is bs=true (buy first). This creates a pattern where: winning trades repeat the same direction, losing trades reverse direction. No indicators used - pure alternating direction with SL/TP exits. The SL/TP values are in points (divided by _Point), so for 5-digit brokers 31 SL means 31 points = 3.1 pips, and for 4-digit brokers 31 points = 31 pips. No digit adjustment is performed in code.
python_conversion_notes: Very straightforward conversion. No indicators to replicate. Key logic: 1) Track a boolean direction flag. 2) On no position, enter market order in flag direction. 3) On TP hit in points, close and keep same direction. 4) On SL hit in points, close and flip direction. 5) Point calculation uses bid-open for buys, open-ask for sells, divided by point_size. Ensure point_size is correctly mapped from the symbol's tick_size/pip_size. The CTrade library is standard MT5 and only provides PositionClose/Buy/Sell wrappers - easily replaced with direct API calls.
